'''''The Living Force''''' is an adult novel by [[John Jackson Miller]] set in the [[33 BBY|year]] before [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. It was published on [[April 9]], [[2024]] in hardcover, audiobook and ebook format and focuses on [[Qui-Gon Jinn]], his apprentice [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and the twelve members of the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]].
